record_type: immutable L3/L10 candidate source and pair receipt

candidate_status.po_adoption: fixed for named parent registrations only

dependencies.owner: Transformation/oracle source owner; LABO evaluates only evidence provided
Experiment source contract and original oracle owner
OS assignment owner and Worker result source; Worker is not authority owner

clause_to_fr.006-1: Input baseline/current, candidate, hybrid hypothesis/conditions/oracle; FR lists each comparison arm and identity.
clause_to_fr.006-2: Execution by OS-assigned Worker; FR and AC preserve OS assignment plus Worker result linkage, same ticket/experiment/target version.
clause_to_fr.006-3: Evaluate all listed dimensions individually; avoid collapsing into an invented weighted score.
clause_to_fr.006-4: Record failures, counterexamples, applicability, cost and limits; distinguish non-comparable/interrupted/unknown from success.
clause_to_fr.006-5: LABO does not select, assign, or start Workers.

normal: N1: same ticket, experiment, target revision, oracle, comparable baseline/current/candidate/hybrid; assigned Worker result linked; report each available metric without declaring success from execution alone.
N2: a distinct unseen experiment fixture with new target revision and different valid oracle, all source identities aligned; verify the same AC without duplicating N1 facts.
individual_negative: X1: only baseline/current version differs; comparison remains non-comparable.
X2: only oracle identity/revision missing or differs; no success/improvement classification.
X3: only OS assignment identity missing; return to OS, do not infer assignment.
X4: only Worker result contract/result source missing; return to result owner, do not score.
X5: only ticket/experiment identity mismatches; do not join observations.
X6: only target version mismatch; do not compare.
X7: only one metric observation missing; retain unknown for that metric and keep it out of valid numerator, do not substitute zero.
X8: execution is interrupted; preserve partial result and interrupted state, not success.
case_plan.owner_return: Missing or stale OS ticket/assignment/source observation → HELIX-OS; Worker result/source contract → its owner; baseline/oracle/condition meaning → original experiment/oracle owner; LABO does not repair source truth.

nfr_candidates.name: comparison evidence completeness vector
nfr_candidates.basis: Fixed L2-006 enumerates quality, success/failure, FP/FN, rework, speed, CI/Worker time, token/API cost, human intervention, context, complexity, recovery time, release lead time, ops load, cross-product reuse.
nfr_candidates.method: Per dimension report observed / valid / missing / not applicable / incomparable / interrupted counts against predeclared eligible experiment arms; preserve each denominator and exact same experiment identity. No scalar score or thresholds.

nfr_candidates.name: identity-link integrity
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-006 and dependencies L2-022/028 require assignment/result linked to same ticket, experiment and target version.
nfr_candidates.method: Report linked complete observations / eligible attempted observations; missing identity stays denominator and is a failure/unknown by the relevant oracle, not removed.

nfr_candidates.name: measurement quality
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-006 says invalid comparisons and interruptions remain visible.
nfr_candidates.method: Report timing/cost/context only when source provides a valid observation; do not treat absent values or incomparable results as zero.

dependencies.owner: Experiment evidence and original oracle owners

clause_to_fr.007-1: Input repeated episodes, experiment evidence, rule candidate and oracle; output evaluation, not execution.
clause_to_fr.007-2: Individually assess same-condition reproducibility, machine decidability, oracle, bounded side effects, retry/rollback, idempotency.
clause_to_fr.007-3: Evaluate both systemization candidate and operation continuation with limits; operation remains valid for contextual dependence, semantic judgment, many exceptions, incomplete oracle, high FP, overconstraint.
clause_to_fr.007-4: Operation→Repeated Stable Decision→Rule Candidate→Shadow→Mechanism Candidate are descriptive assessment stages only; never automatic promotion/new approval.

normal: N1: a rule candidate has evidence for all six conditions under a declared scope; show evidence per condition and leave final adoption with existing authority.
N2: unseen candidate with at least one condition unknown, but operation continuation is evidenced; retain undecidable state as operation candidate.
individual_negative: X1: only same-condition repeatability evidence absent.
X2: only machine-decidability evidence absent.
X3: only oracle missing/incomplete.
X4: only side-effect boundary unbounded.
X5: only retry/rollback evidence absent.
X6: only idempotency evidence absent.
X7: only evidence from L2-016 loses a counterexample; block systemization claim and retain uncertainty.
X8: only candidate stage label is Shadow; it must not automatically promote.
case_plan.owner_return: Missing or disputed experiment/oracle evidence → original experiment/oracle owner; missing system/operation responsibility context → current responsibility owner. LABO does not create qualification or promote.

nfr_candidates.name: six-condition evidence vector
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-007 names the six conditions individually; L2-016 requires comparability and counterexample retention.
nfr_candidates.method: For each condition, report supported/contradicted/unknown and evidence locator over the same candidate-scope denominator; do not average into a score or convert missing to pass.

nfr_candidates.name: candidate-stage state
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-007 says stages are evaluation stages only and excludes auto promotion/new approval.
nfr_candidates.method: Count candidates by observed descriptive stage and outcome, with stage evidence and unresolved conditions; stage labels do not create new gate or automatic transition.

dependencies.owner: Current operational responsibility owner; LABO does not switch operation

clause_to_fr.008-1: Inputs: current system-rule version, operational results, exceptions, false positives, workarounds and change costs.
clause_to_fr.008-2: Output candidate to continue, modify, or return to operation; keep guarantee/operation conditions and unfinished duties.
clause_to_fr.008-3: System is not permanent; operation fallback is a normal improvement candidate, not failure/retirement.
clause_to_fr.008-4: LABO does not execute a switch; missing information returns to current responsibility owner.

normal: N1: versioned current system evidence includes exception, false-positive, workaround/cost evidence; candidate to continue system with conditions and no unfinished-duty loss.
N2: unseen evidence supports return to operation; state operating conditions, guarantee and unfinished duties while no operational switch occurs.
individual_negative: X1: only current-system version absent/stale.
X2: only operational result absent.
X3: only exception evidence missing despite an asserted exception.
X4: only false-positive evidence missing while claiming no false positives.
X5: only workaround burden missing.
X6: only change-cost evidence missing.
X7: only unfinished duty omitted from fallback candidate.
X8: only current owner/operational result disputed; return rather than assume.
case_plan.owner_return: Version, operational outcome, exception/workaround/cost, guarantee or duty missing → current responsibility owner; no LABO-executed fallback/switch.

nfr_candidates.name: evidence and obligation retention
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-008 / L2-017 require operational evidence, alternatives, guarantee and unfinished duties.
nfr_candidates.method: Per reevaluation candidate report required evidence fields present/unknown and unfinished-duty IDs preserved/source-linked; missing remains explicit.

nfr_candidates.name: candidate disposition profile
nfr_candidates.basis: Continue, modify, or operation fallback are explicit alternatives.
nfr_candidates.method: Report candidate dispositions with supporting evidence and counterexamples; no target rate, permanent-system objective, or automatic switch.

clause_to_fr.009-1: Output supported scope level among single episode, repeated episodes, cross-project, cross-product, general structure.
clause_to_fr.009-2: For each scope retain evidence, counterexample, sample conditions; a single episode cannot justify broader scope.
clause_to_fr.009-3: Separate Feedback destination by scope; product-specific meaning is not sent to BRAIN; no unsupported generic structure.
clause_to_fr.009-4: Counterexample/out-of-scope condition narrows supported scope and returns to original evidence.

normal: N1: multiple evidence items with explicit project/product and applicability conditions support only repeated-episode scope; output that bounded scope.
N2: distinct unseen multi-project fixture with counterexample outside one condition; verify supported scope narrows to the evidence-supported level.
individual_negative: X1: only comparison result unavailable/invalid.
X2: only sample condition missing.
X3: only counterexample omitted.
X4: only applicability/scope boundary missing.
X5: only cross-product evidence absent while cross-product claim asserted.
X6: only product-specific meaning routed toward BRAIN.
X7: only generic-structure claim lacks general evidence.
X8: only one episode offered for repeated/cross-project scope.
case_plan.owner_return: Missing experiment, sample condition, scope or counterexample → original evidence owner; product-specific meaning remains with its target owner, not redirected to BRAIN.

nfr_candidates.name: scope evidence matrix
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-009 lists five scope levels and requires scope-bounded support plus counterexamples.
nfr_candidates.method: For each claim level report supporting and contradicting evidence counts/IDs and applicable sample conditions, without minimum sample-size threshold unless the source owner defines one.

nfr_candidates.name: scope overclaim detection
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-009 and L2-018 prohibit exceeding evidence and require narrowing on counterexample.
nfr_candidates.method: Report claims with scope above evidence-supported level / all scope claims; missing scope/sample/counterexample remains denominator and marks claim unknown/unassessed.

dependency_fields: target identity and target responsibility candidate
unknown target returned as routing candidate only
dependencies.owner: OS routing and target responsibility source owners

clause_to_fr.010-1: Derive one or more target-specific Feedback proposals from evaluated episodes, experiments, counterexamples, scope.
clause_to_fr.010-2: Require each of the 16 listed fields without inference/fabrication: source_episode; source_revision; target_mechanism; target_responsibility; observation; evidence; failure_or_success; hypothesis; experiment; result; counterexample; scope; confidence; regression_risk; recommended_action; revalidation_condition.
clause_to_fr.010-3: Recommended action limited to the exact eight listed values: maintain, redefine, replace, split, merge, systemize, operational_fallback, retire.
clause_to_fr.010-4: Keep proposal non-authoritative; OS owns registration/routing; target owner owns changes; missing mandatory evidence returns to owner.

normal: N1: complete 16-field feedback proposal for one target, valid action enum, evidence/scope/counterexample linked; remains proposal and is not routed/registered by LABO.
N2: one experiment supports two distinct targets; create separate target-specific proposals preserving each responsibility and evidence without merging target authority.
individual_negative: X1-X16: for each of the 16 mandatory fields independently remove or mismatch only that field and verify proposal is returned/incomplete, not guessed: source_episode; source_revision; target_mechanism; target_responsibility; observation; evidence; failure_or_success; hypothesis; experiment; result; counterexample; scope; confidence; regression_risk; recommended_action; revalidation_condition.

X17-X24: for each of the eight action values independently submit an unsupported/invalid enum value; reject that value without inventing an alternative: maintain; redefine; replace; split; merge; systemize; operational_fallback; retire.
X25: only target identity unknown; preserve as OS routing candidate, not confirmed target routing.
X26: only target responsibility/evidence revision mismatches; return to target/original evidence owner.
X27: only scope/counterexample is broader/inconsistent; no proposal claim beyond L2-009 supported scope.
case_plan.owner_return: Any missing mandatory field/evidence → source owner for that field; target mechanism/responsibility ambiguity → target responsibility owner and OS routing owner as candidate routing only. LABO cannot register, route, create ticket, change authority, or change target.

nfr_candidates.name: proposal field completeness
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-010 and L2-019 enumerate 16 mandatory fields and target identity/evidence.
nfr_candidates.method: Denominator is all eligible derived feedback proposals before field validation; separately report complete proposals and each field-present count. Missing field remains in denominator, not dropped.

nfr_candidates.name: target/action integrity
nfr_candidates.basis: L2-010 defines target-specific proposals and eight-value action enum, with OS registration/routing and target-owner change ownership.
nfr_candidates.method: Report proposals with valid target identity/responsibility/action and separately count unknown target, invalid action, or owner mismatch; no inferred routing or change.
